73 passing regression and adjacent unit tests, including incomplete/single-output trajectory boundaries, already-packed latent passthrough, and the already-fixed grouped residency-manager installation. Log: reports/j-ff98d30c0ca9/raw/final-unit-tests.log
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, and policy hooks for all changed Python files.
